2102. Converting a Lowercase Letter to Uppercase Using ASCII Arithmetic

95

Problem Statement
Read a lowercase letter and convert it to uppercase using arithmetic on its ASCII value, without using any built-in case-conversion function.
Description
Read a single lowercase character. Compute and print the resulting uppercase character using arithmetic operation.
